title: Sick Of It
style: Dark fantasy video game character art: painterly, detailed, gritty, warm rim light from hellfire, readable silhouette.
notes: Story first (sickofitgame-unity/Docs/Story.md): the climb through 1,000 floors of Hell, Hell is repetition, slimes are villagers and never enemies, no office or work jokes. Enemy art for the game goes through Tools/Art/art.mjs (it calls Hawkes Gen); these presets are for concepts, backdrops and music. The style line is the one art.mjs uses.

enemy-concept.description: A Hell enemy concept, full body side view on green (feed it to art.mjs as a reference).
enemy-concept.prompt: {prompt}. Full-body side profile view, turned to face right, centered with empty space around it; the whole body visible. A single creature, nothing else. {style} Plain flat pure green background, no floor, no shadow.

floor-backdrop.description: A side-view background for a stretch of Hell's floors.
floor-backdrop.prompt: Side-scrolling video game background, a floor of Hell: {prompt}. Empty of characters, layered depth, {style}

floor-music.description: A floor theme: 90s arcade energy, loopable.
floor-music.prompt: {prompt}, 90s arcade video game soundtrack, driving, loopable, instrumental

announcer.description: Hell's announcer line (booming 90s arcade). Set voice to the announcer voice id from audio.json.

kinds._about: What each kind of entity is made of, for the Hawkes Gen library (docs/library.md). The prompts are Tools/Art/art.mjs's (sickofitgame-unity); art.mjs keeps an enemy's look (its description) and each pose's and clip's brief (the action) on the entity, and a clip's from/to poses as {from} and {to}.

enemy.description: An enemy: a standing side view facing right on green, poses made from it, and a clip per animator state (idle, move, attack, hurt, die).

pose/stand.description: Standing, full body, side profile facing right, on green: every other pose is made from it.

params.prompt: Paint {look}, {brief}. Full-body side profile view, turned to face right, centered in the frame with plenty of empty space around it; the whole body is visible from head to toe. A single character, nothing else. {style} Plain flat pure green background (#00ff00), no floor, no shadow, no scenery, even studio lighting. {feedback}

pose/*.description: A pose made from the stand pose; the slot's brief is the action.

params.prompt: Image 1 is this creature, side view, facing right. Show the exact same creature {brief}. Keep everything about it the same as image 1: face, body, colors, proportions and art style, and the same size and position in the frame. Side view, facing right. The whole body is visible. Plain flat pure green background (#00ff00), no floor, no shadow, no scenery, even studio lighting. {feedback}

clip/*.description: A clip from its from pose to its to pose (pose/{from} -> pose/{to}); the brief is the action.

params.prompt: {name}, {look}, {brief}. Side view, facing right, full body, staying in place in the center of the frame. Locked camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Plain flat pure green background (#00ff00), no floor, no shadow, no scenery, even studio lighting. Clear, snappy motion for a 2D arcade game. {feedback}
